name: crescent_block
notes: A curved terrace of ochre stucco 24 m along the chord and 10 m deep, four storeys under a terracotta roof, whose front is a concave arc with a 3 m sagitta, as on the outside of a round place, with a ground-floor arcade of six arches over a covered walk. The front faces local -Z; the straight side walls are plain party walls.
